questions.question: What is the main purpose of Business Intelligence?
options: To store business data without analysing it
To analyse data and support business decisions
To replace every operational business system
To create charts without interpreting results
questions.why: Business Intelligence helps convert business data into useful insights for informed decisions.

questions.question: A retail store recorded ₹80,000 in Week 1 and ₹56,000 in Week 2. What is the percentage change?
Cloud Hosting has a budget of ₹4 lakh and actual spending of ₹5.2 lakh. What is its budget variance (Actual − Budget)?
questions.why: Variance = ₹5.2 lakh − ₹4 lakh = +₹1.2 lakh, which is overspending.

questions.question: Sales averages 60 employees and 9 leave. Customer Support averages 40 employees and 8 leave. Which has the higher attrition rate?
questions.why: Sales: 9 ÷ 60 × 100 = 15%. Customer Support: 8 ÷ 40 × 100 = 20%. Customer Support is higher.

questions.question: A BI dashboard highlights unusually high attrition. What is the most appropriate next step?
options: Assume salary is the main reason
Immediately increase salaries for all employees
Investigate employee feedback and relevant workforce data
questions.why: BI identifies a pattern; further investigation is needed to establish causes and choose an appropriate response.
